semantics.coverage_kind: Observed Python lines, not exhaustive dependency evidence.
semantics.fixture_shared_policy: Select all recorded consumers; empty or uncertain consumers require all tests.
semantics.global_shared_policy: Select all incoming tests if affected.
semantics.identity_table: Canonical pytest node IDs; table offsets are not manifest numbers.
semantics.sets: Sorted inclusive ranges of identity/shared-context table offsets.

unbacked_execution.policy: No fabricated source paths; changes to dynamic code or uncertain dependencies require conservative fallback.
